official.deadline_note: TSLS publishes no closing date on the scheme page, and the scheme page itself currently returns a 404 error. The TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook states that all applications must be successfully submitted before the application closing date and that late and incomplete applications will not be considered for assessment, so the date is announced through the TSLS Apply portal and TSLS social media channels.
official.application_cycle: 2026-2027 Financial Year (TSLS 2027 Scholarship Policies Handbook, published September 2026)
official.status_note: The scheme's own page on tsls.com.fj returns a 404 error on repeated checks, and the scheme does not appear among the nine scholarship schemes listed in TSLS's 2027 Scholarship Policies Handbook for the 2026-2027 Financial Year, which contains only the Cost Sharing Overseas PhD, Postgraduate Diploma Local, In-Service Public Sector, National Distinction, Students With Special Needs, National Achievement (Higher Education, Rural Remote and Maritime, and Skills Qualification) and Hardship Assistance schemes. No current open round can therefore be confirmed. The TSLS Apply portal remains live and linked as 'Apply Now'.
eligibility: Be ordinarily resident in Fiji for at least three (3) years before the award commencement date unless determined otherwise by the Service
Have completed Year 13 in 2025, or as determined by the Service at the time of application; applicants who completed Foundation Studies or repeated Year 13 are not eligible
Score 340/400 and above in the Year 13 examination and apply in a listed programme for the Overseas Scholarship
Secure a place at an eligible institution by means of a final offer letter
Not be an existing TSLS sponsored student or graduate on active bond service, or sponsored through any other agency
requirements: Register on TSLS Apply, complete the online form and submit the application
Hold a final offer letter from one of the listed eligible institutions
Apply in a listed priority discipline and programme
Meet the standard TSLS rule that late and incomplete applications will not be considered for assessment
documents: Final offer letter from an eligible institution
Year 13 examination result showing 340/400 or above
Evidence of Fiji citizenship and three years of ordinary residence in Fiji

The standard TSLS document set: Tax Identification Number, digital passport photo, birth certificate, medical report where applicable, highest qualification result, bank, Mpaisa or MyCash statement where applicable, parents pay slip or statutory declaration, and guardianship or care home confirmation where applicable
selection_criteria: A quota of 80 awards allocated across priority disciplines: Engineering Services (10), Medical and Health Services (10), Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (10), Information Technology Services (20), Science and Innovation - Meteorology (10), Business and Commerce (10) and Special Areas (10)
A Year 13 score of 340/400 or above in a listed programme at one of the eligible institutions

Eligible institutions are 20 universities in Australia and New Zealand, including Auckland University of Technology, Griffith, Massey, Monash, QUT, Swinburne, University of Auckland, Canberra, Canterbury, Newcastle, UNSW, Queensland, Sydney, Waikato, Victoria University of Wellington, Western Sydney, Otago, RMIT and University of Southern Queensland
application_method: Register on TSLS Apply and create an account using your own email address (Gmail, Yahoo or Hotmail)
Select the eligible scheme under View Programs and complete each task, marking it complete as you go
Upload the required documents in pdf, png or jpg format
Accept the declaration and submit, then track status under My Application
official.application_route: Online through the TSLS Apply portal, which the scheme page links to as 'Apply Now'; however the scheme page itself is currently unavailable, so confirm with TSLS before relying on this scheme.

official.international_eligibility: No - open only to Fiji citizens
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants must apply in a listed priority discipline and programme, with 80 awards spread across Engineering Services (10), Medical and Health Services (10), Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (10), Information Technology Services (20), Science and Innovation - Meteorology (10), Business and Commerce (10) and Special Areas (10)
official.description: A TSLS statutory scheme listed on the Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service schemes page as the High Achievers Higher Education (Level 7) Overseas Scheme, advertised for Fiji citizens who completed Year 13 with 340/400 or above and who hold a final offer from a listed Australian or New Zealand university in a priority discipline. The scheme's own page is currently unavailable and it is not listed among the schemes in TSLS's 2027 Scholarship Policies Handbook for the 2026-2027 Financial Year.
official.program_type: Government scholarship (Fiji Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service statutory scheme)

not_confirmed: whether the scheme is currently offered at all
verification.notes: The scheme page at tsls.com.fj/high-achievers-higher-education-level-7-overseas-scheme/ returns a 404 error on repeated direct checks, and the scheme is absent from the nine scholarship schemes listed in the official 2027 TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook (2026-2027 Financial Year), whose Scholarship Schemes Privileges schedule covers no overseas scheme other than the Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scheme. The eligibility, document and quota wording shown here was recorded from the official page when it was live and cannot be re-verified now; no benefit amount is published anywhere on the official domain, so no figure is asserted and no coverage flags are set.

applicant_utility.summary: Treat this scheme with real caution. The page that describes it on TSLS's own site currently returns a 404 error, and the scheme is missing from TSLS's 2027 Scholarship Policies Handbook for the 2026-2027 financial year, which lists only nine scholarship schemes and only one overseas scheme (the Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scheme). That does not prove the scheme is dead, but it does mean you cannot confirm its benefits, its duration or even whether it is running without contacting TSLS directly. The eligibility profile on record is very tight and very specific: Fiji citizen, three years ordinary residence, Year 13 completed in 2025 with 340/400 or above, a final offer from one of twenty named Australian and New Zealand universities, and no existing TSLS sponsorship or active bond. If you fit that profile, the sensible move is to email or call TSLS and to check the Apply portal for what schemes it is actually listing this cycle.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Fiji citizens who completed Year 13 in 2025 with a 340/400 or better score and already hold a final offer from a listed Australian or New Zealand university, and who can confirm with TSLS that the scheme is running.
application_readiness_checklist: Email mytsls@tsls.com.fj or call TSLS on +679 8921240 to confirm whether the High Achievers Higher Education (Level 7) Overseas Scheme is being offered in the current cycle
Log in to the TSLS Apply portal and check which schemes are actually listed under View Programs, rather than relying on the schemes web page
Confirm your Year 13 result meets 340/400 and that you did not complete Foundation Studies or repeat Year 13, both of which are disqualifying
Secure a final offer letter, not a provisional one, from one of the eligible Australian or New Zealand universities
Check you are not an existing TSLS sponsored student or a graduate on active bond service, and not sponsored through any other agency
Prepare the standard TSLS document set as pdf, png or jpg scans, keeping file sizes within the published limits
common_rejection_risks: Applying for a scheme whose page and handbook entry cannot be confirmed, then discovering no awards were allocated
Having completed Foundation Studies or repeated Year 13, either of which makes you ineligible
Falling below 340/400 in the Year 13 examination
Holding only a provisional offer where a final offer letter is required
Already being a TSLS sponsored student, a graduate on active bond service, or sponsored by another agency
Failing the three-year ordinary residence test before the award commencement date
Applying in a discipline that is not one of the priority disciplines carrying awards this cycle
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Nothing can be confirmed. The scheme page publishes no benefit breakdown, and the TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook's privileges schedule contains no entry for this scheme, so there is no published basis for saying what is covered. Do not assume the same coverage as the Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scheme, whose published privileges belong to that scheme alone. Airfare, visa costs and living expenses abroad are the obvious exposures to plan for if the scheme is in fact running.
document_audit: The Year 13 result must show 340/400 or above, and TSLS asks for final Year 12 and Year 13 results rather than annual results
The offer letter must be final and from an eligible institution, not provisional and not from an unlisted university
The standard TSLS document list includes a Tax Identification Number, birth certificate and highest qualification result, so gather these before the portal opens
Documents must be scanned in pdf, png or jpg format; the Know How To Apply page states file size should not exceed 5MB
You must register the portal account with your own email address, using Gmail, Yahoo or Hotmail
alerts: The scheme page returns a 404 error and the scheme is absent from the 2027 TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook, so no benefit, duration or deadline can be confirmed
TSLS states that its decision on scholarship applications is final and cannot be appealed, so get the scheme's status settled before you invest in an application
All scholarship offers must be accepted within three days of the date stated in the offer letter, and offers not accepted by the deadline are declined
TSLS awards carry a bond obligation to serve the country on completion, and TSLS operates a Travel and Bond Clearance and Repayment portal and a bond calculator to administer it
TSLS's one overseas PhD scheme for 2026-2027, the Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scheme, has only five awards
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Confirm with TSLS that the scheme is open, register on the TSLS Apply portal, complete the online form with the offer letter and Year 13 results, submit before the announced closing date, then track the outcome on the portal's My Application page and on your registered email.
